title: The two property modules record different construction eras for the same home.
detail: Both modules ask when the home was built, and they now offer the same bands, so a difference between them is a real disagreement rather than two vocabularies talking past each other. The era drives different findings in each: the seismic questions that attach below the 1980 code line, and the systems-age comparison that a claim settlement can turn on [S:ca-10-ccr-2695-183]. One of the two answers is wrong and the findings resting on it are wrong with it.
action: Check the year built on your declarations or county assessor record, then correct whichever module disagrees with it.
author: Aaron Bollinger
